messages:
aisha_ae: Quick heads-up — TrustWave (merchant POC) is asking for a BYO-HSM flow + fallback policy for peak traffic. They want to validate latency impact and a price delta for HSM proxy vs native Redwood KMS.

luke_se: Got it. What are their perf targets?

aisha_ae: Target is <=50ms additional per inference for key unwrap, 99th percentile. They expect multi-AZ HA and rotation every 30 days. Also they want HSM attestation logs for auditors.

marta_sre: 50ms p99 for unwrap is tight but doable with proxy colocated on same AZ as inference pods. We need to confirm network RTT from their environment. For multi-AZ, we recommend active-active with async failover; sync replication across HSMs adds latency.

luke_se: On the price side: add-on for BYO-HSM proxy + cross-AZ egress still. We can model two options: (A) customer-managed HSM in their VPC + lightweight proxy (lower infra cost, more ops on their side) or (B) Redwood-managed proxy with HSM-backed KEK (we handle HA but higher monthly).

aisha_ae: Customer asked for a ballpark delta to include in their SOW tomorrow — can you give a quick guesstimate range?

luke_se: Quick numbers: Option A: +$0.02–0.05 per 1k requests (network egress & proxy infra amortized), Option B: +$2k–6k/mo depending on throughput and SLA. Rough. Need exact after we know qps.

marta_sre: Also note: if they enable KV caching of unwrapped DEKs for short TTLs, we can reduce HSM calls dramatically (saves cost and latency). We'll need an eval prompt set to surface cache-hit ratios.

ops_bot: [sec-audit] Attestation available: certs (=FIPS-140-2) and HSM logs can be forwarded to customer SIEM via syslog/S3. Requires network egress/opening outbound to their collector.

devon_sec: A few compliance blockers to flag: 1) BYO-HSM certificate chain verification — ops needs CA bundle and attestation hash. 2) Rotation every 30 days: confirm whether they require synchronous keywrap re-encryption of all stored DEKs or only new DEKs get wrapped with new KEK. 3) Audit window for access: how long do they want logs retained?

aisha_ae: They said rotation = 30 days, but not sure about rewrap. I'll ask. For logs they want 1 year retained for auditors.

luke_se: Rewrap on rotation is heavy. We support lazy rewrap (new writes use new KEK; old artifacts are rewrapped on access or via offline job). If they need immediate rewrap we have a migration plan but need maintenance window and can impact CPU/IO on datastore.

marta_sre: Also need to confirm HSM vendor compatibility. We have tested with Thales/Safenet and AWS CloudHSM. If they bring a different vendor, we'll need an integration window and potential firmware checks.

ops_bot: [network-check] To meet 50ms p99 we prefer proxy co-located with compute. If customer places HSM in shared colo with >20ms RTT we will hit SLA risk. Recommend a 1-week perf run: 10k synthetic decrypts with candidate network path.

devon_sec: For the security questionnaire: attach sample KMS key policy, rotation diagram, and attestation process. I can draft answers to their vendor security questionnaire if you send it.

aisha_ae: I'll upload their security questionnaire. Also flagged: legal asked about indemnity for customer-managed keys — want to confirm wording.

luke_se: For commercial we can offer an ops credit if they choose Redwood-managed HSM for first 3 months to offset integration risk.

marta_sre: Action items: 1) aisha to upload questionnaire + perf targets, 2) devon to draft sec responses + sample key policy, 3) luke to produce ballpark SOW options A/B, 4) marta to schedule perf run and provide caching recommendation and runbook.

aisha_ae: Great — I'll push questionnaire now and ping TrustWave to permit our perf runner IPs. ETA: EOD tomorrow for initial SOW bullets.

devon_sec: One more — if they insist on immediate rewrap on rotation, include a maintenance SLA and estimate for throughput hit; I can write the exact wording for the SOW.

luke_se: Noted. I'll include optional immediate-rewrap pricing line item.

aisha_ae: Thanks team :thumbsup: — I'll update thread when questionnaire is in.
